title: Cosmic Rollercoaster Cat
description: A surreal night scene depicts a large black horse covered in glowing social media icons and a red heart, ridden by two black cats along a twisting rollercoaster track above a coastal town. The sky is filled with colorful nebulae, stars, comets, and dripping paint effects in magenta, orange, and yellow, while the town below features a building labeled '1000 PAINTINGS GRIND' with illuminated windows and a lighthouse on a pier.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a large black horse covered in colorful social media icons and a glowing red heart, with two black cats riding it on a looping rollercoaster track that runs above a seaside town at night. The sky is a dramatic mix of stormy clouds, colorful nebulae, stars, and flying comets. Vibrant dripping paint effects in pink, orange, and yellow cascade from the top and bottom. A building in the town is labeled '1000 PAINTINGS GRIND'. Highly detailed, vibrant colors against dark background.
